{"note": "d12 Sat 07:02: bedroom_floor_b1 held laundry_basket_shared_1, towel_noa, vacuum_cleaner_shared_1; resident_1 present. Elias's personal items (jacket, phone, keys, wallet, charger, laptop, headphones, pen) all ABSENT. Confirms Elias's items are not static in bedroom_1 floor when he is present. Noa's towel is in bedroom_1, contradicting belief it is static in bathroom.", "fork": {"beliefs": "1. **Elias’s Mobility & Absence:** Elias’s personal items (laptop_elias, headphones_elias, charger_elias, phone_elias, keys_elias, wallet_elias, jacket_elias) are highly mobile and NOT static in bedroom_1 receptacles (bed_b1, nightstand_b1, desk_b1, bedroom_floor_b1) whether he is present or absent. Do not forecast these items in bedroom_1 unless recently observed there. When Elias is present in bedroom_1, he carries NOTHING on person; his items are likely elsewhere in the house or OUT_OF_HOUSE.

2. **Counter_k1 Dynamics:** counter_k1 is a morning hub for Priya’s items (mug_priya, lunchbox_priya, phone_priya, water_bottle_priya) and shared items (medication_bottle_noa). It is NOT reliable for Elias’s items (mug_elias, pen_elias, water_bottle_elias, charger_shared_1 are frequently absent even when Elias is present). Priya’s items are more stable here than Elias’s.

3. **Desk_b1 Specifics:** desk_b1 holds book_noa and notebook_elias. It does NOT reliably hold laptop_elias, headphones_elias, or charger_elias, even when notebook_elias is present. Noa’s book is static here, not in bedroom_2.

4. **Noa’s Items:** Noa’s items (blanket_noa, toy_noa, backpack_noa) are NOT static in bedroom_1 receptacles (bed_b1). They are mobile or elsewhere. Noa’s towel (towel_noa) is NOT static in the bathroom; it was observed in bedroom_floor_b1 on d12. medication_bottle_noa is static in cupboard_k1 but also observed at counter_k1, suggesting it may be moved for morning use.

5. **Shared Items:** suitcase_shared_1 is mobile and observed in bed_b1. pot_shared_1 is static in cupboard_k1. charger_shared_1 is mobile and not reliably at counter_k1. laundry_basket_shared_1 and vacuum_cleaner_shared_1 were observed in bedroom_floor_b1 on d12, suggesting they may be stored or used there.

6. **General Mobility:** Elias’s personal items show time-dependent instability and are rarely found in bedroom_1. Shared items (charger, pan, tablet, laundry_basket, vacuum) are mobile. Priya’s grooming items are static in the bathroom. Noa’s medication is primarily in cupboard_k1 but may appear at counter_k1 in the morning. Noa’s towel is mobile between bathroom and bedroom_1.", "why": "The look at bedroom_floor_b1 on d12 showed Elias present but all his personal items absent, contradicting the previous belief that items might be on the floor when he is present. It also showed towel_noa in bedroom_1, contradicting the belief that it is static in the bathroom. These observations necessitate updating beliefs about Elias's item locations and Noa's towel mobility."}}
